user.title: Set up Chickadee
user.description: Chickadee routes your Assist pipeline to a pluggable brain — your own API keys, a local model, or Chickadee Cloud — configured in the Chickadee add-on. A ready-to-use Assist pipeline is created for you.

hassio_confirm.description: The Chickadee add-on is running on this Home Assistant. Add the Chickadee voice pipeline? A ready-to-use Assist pipeline is created for you.
